content:
Ravi S: Creating a small thread for the relnotes we're shipping after the docs migration. Need: two dev-facing bullets, one end-user bullet, Known Issues paragraph, and a final pass on all SDK snippets (Py/TS/Go + CLI). Please keep PRs scoped so we can merge fast.

megan: I'll smoke-test the TS and CLI examples today. Noted: the hosted API now defaults to streaming for chat; I'll add explicit `stream: false` in the non-stream examples to avoid surprise.

kevin: Working on Py + Go snippets. Heads-up: the SDK parameter rename `max_tokens -> max_output_tokens` landed in the latest SDK patch; I'll update examples and add a brief inline comment about the rename.

Ravi S: Ops requested we add two Known Issues lines: 1) "Cold-start requests may observe ~1s added latency as KV cache warms" and 2) "Regional fallback can increase latency during capacity pressure." Add both to the Known Issues paragraph.

l10n-bot: Reminder: any copy changes under /docs/relnotes/ or /content/relnotes/ need i18n keys updated. Include a list of keys in each PR description for extraction.

megan: Found one redirecting link in the migration guide (old vendor CDN). I'll replace with the canonical docs path and include the shortlink mapping in the PR.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5120  updates Py/Go snippets, pins `max_output_tokens`, and adds an inline note about token-count variance after the tokenizer tweak.

megan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5121  TS + CLI snippet updates and the CDN shortlink swap. Also added a dev-note showing explicit `stream: true/false` examples.

preview-bot: Preview build ready: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3580246912 (preview #22).

Ravi S: Quick checklist before merge: 1) confirm preview renders without 404s, 2) snippets run against the preview, 3) l10n keys listed in PRs. If all good, target merge by tomorrow 9:30am PT and publish by noon. Thanks team!

megan: Smoke-tested TS/CLI on preview; snippets run but token counts differ by 1-2 due to tokenizer tweak. Added a short comment to set expectations.

kevin: Verified Py/Go on preview. Outputs match besides minor token-count shifts; added the Known Issues line about embedding drift: "Embedding score distributions may shift slightly after tokenizer update; rebaseline thresholds if you rely on fixed cutoffs."

Ravi S: Perfect. I'll merge after localization checklist is confirmed. If any l10n owners can't make the window, we'll ship EN-only and follow up with localized relnotes.
